title: Morning Star Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Located Directly Across from the Beach in Seaside, Fl, only a 69 feet walk to the beach and a 5 min walk to downtown. Walk to over 35 shops and restaurants from your front door! Prime Location guest cottage!
description_expanded: Description12 ODESSA STREET1 QUEENPrime Seaside Location Steps from the BeachWelcome to Morning Star, a charming Seaside guest cottage perfectly positioned just 69 feet from beach access on Odessa Street. This coveted location places you only a three-minute walk from the Seaside Amphitheater and a five-minute stroll to downtown Seaside, where more than 40 shops and restaurants await. Whether you’re heading to the beach, browsing local boutiques, or enjoying an evening concert, everything Seaside has to offer is right outside your door.Private Coastal Cottage with Lush SurroundingsTucked along a sandy footpath with its own private entrance, Morning Star offers a rare sense of privacy in the heart of Seaside. Surrounded by lush landscaping on a spacious corner lot, this light-filled cottage feels like a hidden retreat while still being steps from the Gulf and Seaside’s iconic streetscape.Serene Main-Level Bedroom RetreatThe main floor features a thoughtfully designed queen bedroom with a newly renovated en-suite bathroom. The spa-like bath includes an LED-lit mirror, single vanity, and a large glass-enclosed walk-in shower. The bedroom is outfitted with dual mounted reading lights, a spacious dresser for storage, and a wall-mounted flat-screen TV—creating a comfortable and calming space to unwind after beach days.Light-Filled Living Space with Juliette BalconyUpstairs, the open-concept living area welcomes you with vaulted ceilings and abundant natural light, giving the space an airy coastal feel. A bistro table for two sits just off the stairs, ideal for casual meals or morning coffee. The adjacent living area features a sofa, club chair, and mounted flat-screen TV—perfect for relaxing after a day in the sun.Well-Appointed Kitchen with Coastal ViewsThe galley-style kitchen is fully equipped for your stay, offering stone countertops, a small dishwasher, full-size refrigerator with freezer, four-burner stove, oven, microwave, toaster, and coffee maker. Glass double doors open to a charming Juliette balcony with seating for two, where you can enjoy treetop views and catch the sound of waves rolling in from just across the street.A Romantic Seaside GetawayWith its unbeatable proximity to the beach, thoughtful design, and intimate setting, Morning Star is the perfect Seaside vacation rental for couples seeking a relaxing, romantic escape by the Gulf. From sunrise beach walks to evenings under the stars, this cottage delivers a true Seaside experience.* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES440 square feetPrime Seaside Location: Just 69 feet to beach access and a 5-minute walk to downtown Seaside, FloridaPrivate Seaside Residential Beach: Odessa Pavilion; access to the largest stretch of private residential beach on 30AResort-Style Amenities Access: Enjoy 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome Tote: Includes 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized Service: Thoughtful service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedParking & Golf Cart Policy: 1 parking pass issued. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR24-000765
